---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"
subtitle: "Supplementary Figure 2"
output: html_document
---

## Load packages and set plotting theme
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr);library(tidyverse);library(tidyr);library(lubridate);library(ggpubr)
library(anytime);library(reshape2);library(ggplot2);library(RColorBrewer);library(readxl)
library(gridExtra);library(grid);library(purrr);library(entropy)
source("../plot_theme.R")
options(scipen = 999)

out_path1 <- paste0("FigS2")
dir.create(out_path1)

position <- read.csv("../00_data/lat_lon.csv")
colnames(position) <- c("country","lon","lat")
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
position[which(position$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"
```

## Prepare and save time series of the relative proportion (RP) of respiratory virus detections
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
# Load and retain variables required for plotting
cols <- c("country", "year", "year_decimal", "virus",
          "AAP", "flu_AAP", "fluA_AAP", "fluB_AAP")

dat_pre <- read.csv("../00_data/multi_vaccine_indirect_precovid19.csv")
dat_post <- read.csv("../00_data/multi_vaccine_indirect_2020-2024.csv")

dat_post <- dat_post[,-37]
dat <- rbind(dat_pre,dat_post)
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, England"),"country"] <- "UK, England"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Scotland"),"country"] <- "UK, Scotland"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Wales"),"country"] <- "UK, Wales"
dat[which(dat$country=="United Kingdom, Northern Ireland"),"country"] <- "UK, Northern Ireland"
dat  <-  dat %>%
  filter((year >= 2016 & year <= 2024)) 

dat <- dat[, cols]

# Save time series of the relative proportion (RP) of respiratory virus detections
saveRDS(dat,"../00_data/ts_RP_virus.rds",compress = "xz")
}
```

# Load saved data 
```{r}
dat <- readRDS("../00_data/ts_RP_virus.rds")
```

# Prepare data
```{r}
dat_rsv = subset(dat ,dat$virus=="RSV")
dat_inf <- dat_rsv
dat_inf$AAP <- dat_inf$flu_AAP
dat_inf$virus <- "IV"
dat_infA <- dat_rsv
dat_infA$AAP <- dat_infA$fluA_AAP
dat_infA$virus <- "IAV"
dat_infB <- dat_rsv
dat_infB$AAP <- dat_infB$fluB_AAP
dat_infB$virus <- "IBV"
dat1 <- subset(dat ,!dat$virus=="RSV")
dat2 <- rbind(dat1,dat_inf,dat_infA,dat_infB,dat_rsv)
```

# Plot
```{r fig.width=30, fig.height=25, dpi=300}
plot_aap_list <- list()
virus_name<- c("IV","IAV","IBV","RSV","PIV","RV","ADV","HMPV")
n = length(virus_name)
for(j in c(1:n))
{
  print(virus_name[j])
  D1 = subset(dat2 ,dat2$virus==virus_name[j])
  
  
  D1 <- D1[order(D1$country, D1$year_decimal), ]
  study_country <- unique(D1$country)
  
  D1$country <- factor(D1$country,
                       levels = position$country[order(position$lat, decreasing = T)],ordered=TRUE)
  #colors_used <- c(rep("white", 1), brewer.pal(6, 'BuPu')) 
  colors_used <- c("white", brewer.pal(8, "BuPu")[3:8]) 
  
  max_AAP <- max(D1$AAP)
  rounded_AAP <- round(max_AAP / 20) * 20
  final_AAP <- pmax(rounded_AAP, max_AAP)

  p1 <- ggplot(D1, aes(year_decimal,country)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill=AAP),color = "white",size=0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors=colors_used, na.value="grey70"
                         ,limits = c(0,final_AAP),breaks=seq(0,100,20)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0),limits = rev(levels(D1$country)) ) + 
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0),breaks=seq(2016,2025,2),limits =c(2015.9,2025)) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept =2020.167, linetype = "dashed", color = "black",size=1.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept =2023, linetype = "dashed", color = "black",size=1.5) +
    labs(title = virus_name[j] ,x="",y="") + 
    #facet_wrap(~ year, scales = "free_x",nrow = 1) +
    mytheme+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text( color="black",vjust = 0.5,hjust = 0.5, angle = 0),
          strip.text = element_text( face = "bold"))+
    theme(legend.key.size = unit(0.5,"cm"),legend.key.width = unit(2,"cm"),legend.key.height  = unit(0.35,"cm"))+
    theme(plot.margin=unit(c(1,0.5,1,0),'lines'),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "gray88"),
          panel.grid.major.x=element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y=element_blank())+  # 设置背景色为灰色)
    guides(fill=guide_colorbar(paste0("RP of ", virus_name[j]," detections (%)"),title.position = "top",
                               title.theme = element_text(size = 20, angle = 0,hjust = 0.5),
                               label.theme= element_text(size = 20),
                               title.vjust = 0.9)) 
  p1 
  
  plot_aap_list[[j]] <- p1
  
}  

p1 <- grid.arrange(grobs = plot_aap_list, ncol = 4)
fpath1 <- paste0(out_path1,"/FigS2_RP_month.pdf")
ggsave(p1,filename = file.path(fpath1),device   = cairo_pdf,  family   = "Arial",
       width =30,height =25)
```
